forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
This week, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. Teams completed 2 visits; no surveys or clearances were finished. So far, 9 zones have been surveyed, 2 declared free, 3 areas released and 1 area cleared. Mines have been found in 1 area.

The officer’s attention is drawn to 12 zones closed by the access feed. No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. No reports or dossiers were held, and no new plan was approved; work remains under plan P03. Rain or wind accounted for 13 team-days lost.

The week 10 forecast, for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is done already, puts mine areas cleared this season at P10 to P90 of 10 to 14, and zones declared free this season at P10 to P90 of 10 to 14.
